title: Record your own voice against the pinyin
summary: Use any recorder on your device to check whether what you produced matches what you planned.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: While speaking, your attention is on the meaning, so tone errors feel invisible. Record a sentence, then play it back and compare it to the pinyin you intended, syllable by syllable. Do not judge the whole take at once: pick one thing per recording, for example whether your third tone actually dips, or whether 不 bù before a fourth tone rose to bú. Keep the clips in a dated folder and listen to an old clip every few weeks, because progress in pronunciation is almost invisible from inside a single week.
